name: EAIBench
description: An AI training energy efficiency benchmark that introduces the Energy-Delay Product of one Epoch (EEDP) metric to quickly and accurately measure energy efficiency of AI training workloads. It covers different energy efficiency dimensions including dominant layers, computation intensities, and memory accesses.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with limited adoption outside the energy-efficient AI training community.
notes: Provides reproducible and meaningful results in minutes, much faster than existing methods.
